cascade: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new arm (harness, provider, tier) is described: its five ratings and reasons are a row of arm_ideas.csv beside the solution, rated before it is built] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=the harness's own tests pass with no model: test_headless_runner.py replays each harness's recorded event stream through a fake program (report, tokens, cost, launch failure, time limit, cancel, escalation), and the Claude Code runner tests pass; the none arm is the zero bound] > public [real=no | when=the arm has an unexpired prior of grade C or better in public_priors.csv beside the solution, set by the prior rule of docs/explanation/public-evidence.md (direct or borrowed from a published live-benchmark row, never estimated); a prior orders unmeasured arms and never outranks a measured result] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=the offline stage passed for the harness and the arm's provider has credentials where we measure: one real case runs end to end and its report is read by hand] > staged [sample=sample:6 | real=yes | gate=competitive | max-age-days=90 | when=the one case passed and a call budget is set with --max-calls: two cases of each kind] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | min-pass-rate=0.94 | max-age-days=90 | when=the staged sample passed its gate, or did not separate the leading arms; the min-pass-rate is the floor an arm must hold here before the hard set counts for it]

hard.cascade: idea [kind=idea | scale=esoi/idea-rating-scale.md | min-pass-rate=0.75 | when=a new arm or instructions pack is described: rated in arm_ideas.csv] > offline [real=no | gate=all-pass | when=each coding case fails as given and passes with a reference fix (checked when the private cases are built), and the runner tests pass] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=all-pass | when=the arm passed the whole stage of metric-delegated-agent-sessions: one hard case, hand-read] > whole [sample=full | real=yes | min-pass-rate=0.66 | max-age-days=90 | when=the one case passed, or it failed on a tier whose stronger rung is being measured: every hard case; the six coding cases must pass, the three judged deliverables are decided by repeated runs]
